nodes.label: Start
nodes.detail: A bug description or failing test starts the Go bug-fix workflow.

nodes.label: Bugfix owner
nodes.detail: Initialize the workflow, load rules and skills, and manage the bounded loop.

nodes.label: Reproduce failure
nodes.detail: Record command, input, failure, and environment; prefer a minimal failing regression path.

nodes.label: Regression test or exception
nodes.detail: Obtain a red automated regression test when practical; otherwise record the exception, substitute validation, and future test trigger.

nodes.label: Evidence reliable?
nodes.detail: Do not change behavior until root-cause evidence is sufficiently reliable.

nodes.label: Add diagnostic probe
nodes.detail: Use the smallest temporary diagnostic log or probe when runtime evidence is insufficient.

nodes.label: Diagnose root cause
nodes.detail: Form one primary root-cause hypothesis with supporting and opposing evidence.

nodes.label: Apply minimal fix
nodes.detail: Fix only the root cause and record patch intent and changed files.

nodes.label: Verify fix
nodes.detail: Run reproduction, regression, impacted package, and build verification.

nodes.label: Loop control
nodes.detail: Exit on success; otherwise continue only while budget and evidence justify another loop.

nodes.label: Compress context
nodes.detail: Compress the current failure evidence before the next diagnosis loop.

nodes.label: Exit check
nodes.detail: Classify success, exhausted budget, repeated failure, low confidence, or verification block.

nodes.label: Submit evidence
nodes.detail: Submit Task Run Evidence with the final status and verification record.
